commercialSourceOptions.label: YuVu
commercialSourceOptions.delivery: Commercial API/feed; sample and approved test feeds available
commercialSourceOptions.limitations: No Foxtel Pay TV; excludes several datacast, religious and horse-racing channels

commercialSourceOptions.label: Gracenote On API
commercialSourceOptions.role: Enterprise linear and streaming availability plus sports identity
commercialSourceOptions.delivery: Entitled APIs, schemas and delta updates
commercialSourceOptions.limitations: Exact AU channel and OTT inventory is entitlement-specific; general VOD availability must not be assumed to cover sport

commercialSourceOptions.label: JustWatch Sports Widget
commercialSourceOptions.delivery: Branded JavaScript widget with partner API key
commercialSourceOptions.limitations: No public raw sports export; verify AU competition coverage and branding constraints

commercialSourceOptions.label: Sportradar Media APIs
commercialSourceOptions.role: Canonical multi-sport fixtures, IDs and reschedules
commercialSourceOptions.delivery: REST JSON/XML and supported push feeds
commercialSourceOptions.limitations: Does not by itself establish Australian viewing availability or access type

commercialSourceOptions.label: Stats Perform / Opta
commercialSourceOptions.role: Official competition fixture and live data
commercialSourceOptions.delivery: REST, WebSocket, push/pull and S3 in JSON/XML
commercialSourceOptions.limitations: No verified all-sport AU availability layer; exact competition and display entitlements are contractual

commercialSourceOptions.label: Simply.TV
commercialSourceOptions.role: Linear EPG, streaming metadata and sports identity
commercialSourceOptions.delivery: API/push in JSON, XML or custom formats
commercialSourceOptions.limitations: Public material does not enumerate Australian channels or services

commercialSourceOptions.label: EPG Service
commercialSourceOptions.delivery: REST/OpenAPI JSON, XMLTV, webhooks and exports
commercialSourceOptions.limitations: Australia is not identified in public coverage material

commercialSourceOptions.label: SportsDataIO Global Sports API
commercialSourceOptions.role: Broad schedules and scores across long-tail sports
commercialSourceOptions.delivery: Commercial API with one consistent global schema
commercialSourceOptions.limitations: No Australian broadcaster or streaming availability layer

negativeFeedback.note: Discovery negatives combine left swipes with explicit unfollows; rates use discovery opportunity exposures in the same sport or competition as the denominator.

coldStartDiversity.definition: Distinct sports represented within the first ten cold-start opportunities.

recommendations.rationale: The discovery action sample is not sufficient to justify changing the balanced mix or first-impression cap.
Keep the current cap of 1 in the first 10 until discovery engagement and negative feedback are both measurable.
No reviewed coverage decisions exist, so changing match or publication thresholds would be instinct rather than evidence.

privacy.note: The dashboard consumes aggregate rows only. It does not weaken product_events RLS or add browser read access.

notes: A zero current missing-marquee rate is a baseline, not proof of a downward trend.
No tuning recommendation is applied automatically.
Behavioural rates use only approved categorical action events and are never inferred from ratings or passive fixture checks.
